title: Increasing Quantum and Income Ceiling of HDB's Open Market Rental Voucher Scheme for Lower-income Families and In Response to Higher Rentals
what_it_is: Increasing Quantum and Income Ceiling of HDB's Open Market Rental Voucher Scheme for Lower-income Families and In Response to Higher Rentals

sections.label: HDB open market rent increases
sections.summary: Average year-on-year open market rent increases for HDB 3-room, 4-room and 5-room flats were 5% in 2021 and 35% in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: In 2021, the average year-on-year increase in open market rents for Housing and Development (HDB) 3-room, 4-room and 5-room flats was 5%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: This increased to 35% in 2022, amid the easing of border restrictions and recovery of non-resident rental demand.

sections.label: HDB rents in 2023
sections.summary: The average year-on-year increase in open market rents for HDB 3-room, 4-room and 5-room flats was 10% in 2023.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The average year-on-year increase in open market rents for HDB 3-room, 4-room and 5-room flats was 10% in 2023.

sections.label: One-year scheme monthly payment
sections.summary: The scheme runs for a one-year period from July 2024 and eligible families receive $300 per month.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The scheme will run for a one-year period from July 2024 and eligible families will receive $300 per month.

sections.label: PPHS flats and voucher amount
sections.summary: There are no plans to increase the voucher amount, but PPHS flats will double to 4,000, up from about 800 in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: At the moment, there are no plans to increase the voucher amount, but do not forget that we do have plans to double or to increase the number of PPHS flats.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: There would be those who would be able to afford, to rent on the open market, whether private or HDB.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Then, remember, in 2021, when we first introduced the PPHS, we started at about 800 PPHS units; which, in 2022, we then said we would be increasing to 840.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: And then by 2023, we actually more than doubled it to about 2,000.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: And now, we will be doubling it to 4,000.
